subject: steam1
label: sprites/steam1.spr, in the place of the game's own

againstClass.words: starts too bright: an attack in its envelope
does not end dark: a decay in its envelope

R1.reason: The single frame shows a flat grey field with a small dark box with a white edge near the top left (about the top sixth of the frame). It has no soft white or grey steam cloud, so it does not read as a puff of steam from a pipe.

R2.reason: The frame is 32 x 48 as the brief's size allows, but the effect does not fill it. The only shape is a small rectangle at the top, with the rest flat grey. A puff would spread across the frame.

R3.reason: The background is a mid grey, which the brief names, but there is no white in any billowing form. The only white is the thin border of the small dark box. The colours are close to right but the white-and-grey steam is missing, so this is clearly off.

R4.reason: One frame only, so there is no swelling or thinning, which the brief asks for. The measures fail the smoke puff class: the peak is at 0 (class 0.2 to 0.6), the first frame is 1 (class 0 to 0.35, an attack, so it starts bright), and the last is 1 (class 0 to 0.1, so it does not end dark). The envelope is wrong on every count.

R5.reason: Measured and matching: type is parallel oriented and format index alpha, the same as the game's file (gameType and gameFormat). The name is the same (sameName) and the file reads back (readsBack). Nothing in the pictures contradicts this.
